title: A House for the Winter
author: Kestrel Amberdale
blurb: Elodie Joubert, a radio host taking calls from listeners who died last week, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. But when the village's church bell rings although the bell was melted down in 1911, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must get the family out ahead of the count, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
